title: Una relación compleja
goal: Read a closing synthesis of the unit: intervention and economic dependency were real, but so were migration, cultural exchange, and mutual influence.

items: Summarize the pattern of asymmetry covered across this unit.
Explain why the relationship can't be reduced to domination alone.
Describe how migration, investment, and tourism created deep ties.
State the two main interpretations historians debate today.
Use así como to draw parallels and add related ideas.
